k18_quotation.note: K18 was decided FAIL against the T2 registrations. These are its numbers, quoted; T4 does not revisit the verdict.

question: is X's task gain at a measured pooled-KL regression Pareto-useful under matched inference cost?

t4_registration.decision_rule: WIN iff the paired PC difference (X - D_kl) has a 95% CI lower bound at or above the minimum absolute effect AND the pooled-KL difference's 95% CI is compatible with zero at the registered tolerance. Otherwise MISS, with the recorded next route.
t4_registration.kl_target_source: X's pooled teacher KL, from the same receipt
t4_registration.minimum_absolute_effect_derivation: ceil(paired CI half-width of the K18 PC comparison to the next 0.01): an effect below the instrument's own resolution is not a win condition
t4_registration.secondary: pooled teacher KL (mixed interleaving), lower is better
